known_divergences.tiebreaker: ADR-0006 §2 pins Tiên Thiên Ly to position 3 (binary [1,0,1]). The composer's COMPOSITION_TABLE is built against the dominant convention; a maintainer flipping Ly's Tiên Thiên position would silently rotate 8 hexagrams and break CRIT-3. Treated as Open Research Question per 20-RESEARCH.md Open Question #1.
known_divergences.note: PROVISIONAL tiebreaker (Frozen by ADR-0006 / 20-RESEARCH.md Q1 Open Question) — the sub-school variant is acknowledged but not adopted; the dominant convention is canonical. Reviewer should confirm Q1 pin holds across all Vietnamese practitioner references.

deferral.reason: Sub-school variance for Ly's Tiên Thiên position flagged in v1.7 research (20-RESEARCH.md Q1); majority Vietnamese practitioner reference uses ADR-0006's pinned convention. The sub-school variant would not change the Mai Hoa casting algorithm's output (since the algorithm is keyed by sum%8, not by specific trigram identity), but it WOULD change which hexagram is composed for a given (upper, lower) trigram pair. Treated as Open Research Question per 20-RESEARCH.md.

known_divergences.our_value: Single cast on the higher-precision hour-bucket (one chi_hour_index = 0..=11 per 2-hour window; caller is responsible for the early-Tý (23:00-00:00) vs late-Tý (00:00-01:00) split per DEC-0017). cast_mai_hoa treats hour as the Lunar hour index directly.

source_values.url_or_ref: Mai Hoa Dịch Số — Phần II: Cách lập quẻ Mai Hoa
source_values.value: Cast takes the hour index 0..=11; the early/late Tý split is the CALLER's responsibility (some sources state it explicitly, some leave it implicit)

source_values.url_or_ref: vi.wikipedia Mai Hoa Dịch Số §Phân chia giờ
source_values.value: Tý hour spans two civil hours (23:00-01:00). Some Mai Hoa schools treat early-Tý (23:00-24:00) as Tý (index 0) and late-Tý (00:00-01:00) as Tý (index 0); others split. The convention is the CALLER's choice.

known_divergences.tiebreaker: The Mai Hoa algorithm itself takes a single hour index per cast. The DEC-0017 split (early-Tý vs late-Tý) is the CALLER's concern, NOT the algorithm's. cast_mai_hoa outputs deterministically from (year_branch, month, day, hour) — the bucket precision is the caller's responsibility. Documented in Plan 22-01 deviations.
known_divergences.note: Treated as CALLER responsibility (not a divergence in the cast). Logged here for audit: any reported divergence about Tý-hour results should first verify the caller's hour-bucket convention. The dataset does not fabricate a second cast for early-Tý vs late-Tý because the algorithm is invariant to which Tý-bucket convention the caller uses, as long as the caller passes the same index consistently.

deferral.reason: Pre-existing DEC-0017: caller-side hour bucket precision (early-Tý vs late-Tý). No algorithm change required; the divergence resolution is caller-education. Expected review when call-site documentation matures.
